A '''standard-class starport''',<ref name="ST">{{StoryCite|story=Simple Tricks|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref> or '''standard class starport''',<ref name="RP">{{JournalCite|2|Rebel Privateers!}}</ref><ref name="PSG" /> was a type of [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]].<ref name="GG6" />

==Description==
The standard-class [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] had a fully staffed and equipped [[Control tower/Legends|control tower]].<ref name="GG6" /> This type of port offered [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] and resupply services.<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> It had a small [[Shipyard/Legends|maintenance facility]] capable of minor repairs and modifications. These services could cost up to double the normal price and take more than twice as long to accomplish.<ref name="GG6" /> The quality of the work often varied from mediocre to very good.<ref name="PSG" />

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]] was the site of numerous [[Industrial Starport]]s. Each Industrial Starport consisted of a standard-class starport, huge raw material storage facilities, several large [[Factory/Legends|factories]], warehouses, apartments for the working staff, administrative offices, and a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of twenty-four [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]].<ref name="TSoK">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The standard-class starport was created by [[Mark Rein-Hagen]] and [[Stewart Wieck]] for ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook published in [[1990]] by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG6" />
